decision_question: How many terminal conditions are needed for the already-frozen retention, loss-removal, and Wilson gates to be informative at the observed baseline firing rate?

pre_score_integrity_hardening.zero_admissible_segment_action: record rejected status; do not convert; delete only the session-owned frame log when explicitly enabled
pre_score_integrity_hardening.support_stopping_rule: unique officially resolved post-registration condition IDs only
pre_score_integrity_hardening.support_count_integrity_gate: only fully sealed segments with complete ready resolution groups, positive distilled events, and exact resolution-manifest cardinality contribute support

source_authority.forward_capture_state_at_amendment: segment 003 was still recording and had not been finalized, replayed, or scored

old_floor_diagnostic.interpretation: The old floor is suitable only as a pipeline smoke test. It is underpowered for the registered effect and makes loss removal depend on only a few observations.

amended_floor_diagnostic.interpretation: The amended floor gives the screen approximately 100 selected observations at its registered effect size and makes both Wilson and loss-removal evidence decision-useful.

method.registered_effect_selected_win_rate: (79/102 * 0.90) divided by the registered-effect selected rate.
method.wilson: Two-sided 95% Wilson lower bound with z=1.959963984540054, evaluated at rounded expected counts.
method.sample_size_rule: Choose a fixed condition count before forward scoring; do not stop based on observed winners, losses, residuals, or screen rates.

collection_boundary.paired_book_freshness: both recorded book ages must be finite and <= 30000 ms
collection_boundary.screen_source_hashes: all opportunity and resolution inputs are SHA-256 pinned and revalidated by the repeat audit
collection_boundary.extended_block_1_collection: after the 120-condition stability canary, collect at most 96 additional 24-window segments and stop when 750 unique ready conditions are present
collection_boundary.extended_collection_disclosure: condition support count only; winner, loss, residual, retention, Wilson, PnL, and opportunity metrics remain sealed
collection_boundary.extended_collection_storage: convert and retain only condition IDs admitted by the causal-tape audit

limitations: The 102 / 631 firing rate uses exact executed baseline trades as a conservative proxy for reconstructed baseline-eligible opportunity conditions; exposure and state gates can suppress executions, so the forward screen may contain more baseline candidates.
Historical firing and loss rates are nuisance-parameter estimates and may drift; the fixed 750-condition floor avoids adapting to that drift after collection begins.
The amendment improves support but does not prove profitability, fillability, payoff geometry, breadth, or tail stability.
Passing two screens still authorizes only one exact measured-latency runtime replay candidate, not live or paper trading.
